gate: ER3 corpus dual lens (erlang) — full corpus, chunked, two independent implementations
method: Every .erl file in otp@de741b7, rebar3@3c1b417 and cowboy@c965d1a — all 4,326 of them, no stride sample. Both lenses read the same parse tree: the analyzer, and a second implementation of the whole contract written from the language reference (script/m14/tmp/erlang-oracle.ts). Agreement is exact on every axis: every relationship either is derived by the oracle from the grammar or is counted in a named, written-down boundary class. 32 chunks, each a fresh process, because the WASM parser cannot survive a corpus in one (three separate failures forced that; see erlang-census-all.sh).

macroModuleRemotes.meaning: a remote call or fun value whose MODULE is a macro names no derivable callee; only `?MODULE:f/1` does

wholeFileGrammarDamage.meaning: wx api_gen code-generation markup and OTP's abstract-format `-record #r{}` are unparseable; a file with no recoverable declaration of any kind yields nothing rather than edges recovered from error-recovery wreckage
